title: Guest Chat answer screenshots can omit the asserted assistant reply
surface: Hosted native guest Chat acceptance evidence
organization_context: No account token, profile or organization
preconditions: Exact v0.2.532 candidate loaded in an owned guest browser profile.
Three real page-grounded assistant replies complete in the side panel.
reproduction: Inspect the successful native guest Chat report from hosted run 39096823813.
Open the three retained answer screenshots. They show the bottom composer instead of the assistant answer that the report asserts was visible.
Observe that capture() calls Page.captureScreenshot without scrolling the latest assistant article into the viewport; the reply observer accepts a positive DOM rectangle even when it is offscreen.
expected: Each answer screenshot is taken only after the latest assistant article has been scrolled into and intersects the panel viewport, and its text still contains the unpredictable fixture code and required heading.
actual: Run 39096823813 reported a pass and saved three answer screenshots that omit the asserted reply. The screenshots cannot serve as visual confirmation of the answers; the historical .532 report remains immutable but its visual evidence is invalid.
reproducibility: All three retained .532 answer screenshots omit the asserted answer; a focused DOM test reproduces an offscreen but DOM-visible latest article.
severity: S2: native acceptance reports a visually unsupported pass.
priority: P1: require answer-in-viewport proof before the next guest Chat screenshot.
cause: The observer's visible predicate checks nonzero bounds and computed display/visibility, while capture() saves the current viewport without positioning the answer or checking viewport intersection.
sibling_census: The same capture path writes opening, same-conversation follow-up and post-reload answer screenshots. All three now pass the same latest-article viewport and fixture-text gate; diagnostic failure screenshots retain their unrestricted capture path.
reviewer: Independent focused peer review: behavior PASS, code quality PASS; native retest pending.
acceptance_criteria: Reject an offscreen answer even when it has a nonzero DOM rectangle and correct fixture text.
After scrolling, require the latest assistant answer to intersect the viewport and still contain the unpredictable code and follow-up heading where applicable.
Independently review a resource-valid native retest whose retained screenshots visibly show each asserted answer on an exact artifact.

verification.focused: 27/27 guest-answer-screenshot and guest-chat-store-sequence tests pass; pnpm compile, focused Biome and git diff --check pass.
verification.peer: Independent peer verdict A PASS and B PASS.
verification.native: Pending guarded hosted retest on corrected exact artifact; no browser or release run launched in this lane.

limitations: The historical .532 report's transport and DOM assertions are preserved, but its answer screenshots provide no visual confirmation.
The new helper checks article-viewport intersection; a native retest must confirm the answer itself appears in each retained image.
next_action: Publish a corrected exact artifact, run one guarded hosted guest Chat acceptance, inspect all three answer screenshots and obtain independent native review before closing this defect.
